name: Ascend Bio Labs
reputationSummary: US-domestic storefront publishing batch-level certificates from Vanguard Laboratory (Olympic Analytical LLC, Olympia WA), an ISO/IEC 17025:2017 lab accredited under A2LA certificate 6377.01. Certificates carry HPLC purity and assay, ICP-MS heavy metals, LAL endotoxin and USP <71> sterility. Domain registered 2025-11-29. The storefront advertises LC-MS identity testing on every batch; the certificates examined do not include an identity test.
